_comment: Copy this file to distribution_targets.json (gitignored) and fill in real values. Each target is one server/channel the signal feed broadcasts to. Add as many as you like. Filters (strategies / min_setup_score / min_conviction) are optional; omit them to receive everything. Only account-agnostic, sanitized signals are ever sent (no equity, dollars, sizes, or keys) — see signal_publisher.py.
